Rule provides for consideration of H.R. 4850 with 1 hour of general debate. Previous question shall be considered as ordered without intervening motions except motion to recommit. Provides for the consideration of the bill in the Committee of the Whole. The resolution makes in order the consideration of the amendment in the nature of a substitute recommended by the Committee on Energy and Commerce now printed in the bill as an original bill for the purpose of amendment. Said substitute shall be considered read and not subject to amendment except as specified by this resolution. Specified amendments are in order. Only amendments printed in the report accompanying this resolution and amendments specified in sec. 2 of this resolution are in order.
